Please add the ability to share the QR image directly to PhonePe and scan/pay from it, without saving it first. When someone shares a QR code on WhatsApp, we currently have to save the image to the gallery and then upload it in PhonePe. This is unnecessarily inconvenient and can even lead to sending money to the wrong person if multiple QR codes are shared in between. Google Pay has had this for a long time. Please bring it to PhonePe too—it would make payments much faster, easier, and safer.
